profile.name: Windows Server 2025 CUI Baseline
profile.description: High-value technical controls for Windows Server 2025 member servers in a CUI boundary (account policy, audit, firewall, BitLocker, Defender, AppLocker, crypto).

controls.rationale: Authorized access control; local accounts and policy evidence.
Concurrent session control; policy and logon evidence.
Session lock; screen saver and policy.
Remote access control; RDP and policy.
Remote access monitoring; audit and policy.
Media access; BitLocker and access control.

checks.expected_setting: Minimum password length >= 14; account lockout threshold and duration configured; password complexity enabled.

validation.hint: PasswordPolicy and LockoutPolicy in secpol or RSOP

checks.remediation_guidance: Configure via GPO or Local Security Policy: Computer Configuration > Windows Settings > Security Settings > Account Policies. Set minimum password length, lockout threshold (e.g. 5), lockout duration (e.g. 15 min), and enable complexity.

checks.expected_setting: Deny logon locally and Deny access from network restricted to authorized accounts; local admin group minimized.
checks.remediation_guidance: Restrict 'Deny logon locally' and 'Allow logon through Remote Desktop Services' via GPO. Limit local Administrators group; use LAPS or equivalent for local admin passwords.

checks.expected_setting: Audit policy categories enabled for success and failure where required (logon, account logon, object access, policy change, privilege use, system).
checks.remediation_guidance: Enable required audit subcategories via GPO or auditpol. At minimum: Account Logon, Logon, Object Access (where used), Policy Change, Privilege Use, System.

checks.expected_setting: Security event log ACL restricted; only SYSTEM and authorized accounts have write/delete; backup operators may have read where required.
checks.remediation_guidance: Restrict permissions on %windir%\System32\winevt\Logs\Security.evtx. Ensure only SYSTEM and designated audit role have full control; remove unnecessary write for non-SYSTEM.

checks.expected_setting: All firewall profiles (Domain, Private, Public) enabled; default inbound action Block; default outbound Allow; logging enabled for allowed and blocked.
checks.remediation_guidance: Enable Windows Firewall for all profiles. Set default inbound to Block. Enable logging: Set-NetFirewallProfile -LogAllowed True -LogBlocked True.
manual_commands: Get-NetFirewallProfile | Format-List Name, Enabled, DefaultInboundAction, DefaultOutboundAction, LogAllowed, LogBlocked
Get-NetFirewallRule | Select-Object DisplayName, Enabled, Direction, Action, Profile | Export-Csv C:\Temp\firewall-rules.csv -NoTypeInformation

checks.expected_setting: Only required listening ports; no unnecessary services bound to 0.0.0.0 or all interfaces.
checks.remediation_guidance: Disable or firewall unused services. Review Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen and remove or restrict unneeded listeners.
manual_commands: Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen | Select-Object LocalAddress, LocalPort, OwningProcess | Sort-Object LocalPort

checks.expected_setting: OS drive (C:) encrypted with BitLocker; protection on; encryption method AES-256 or XTS-AES; recovery key escrowed per policy.
checks.remediation_guidance: Enable BitLocker on OS volume: Enable-BitLocker -MountPoint C: -EncryptionMethod XtsAes256 -RecoveryPasswordProtector. Back up recovery key to AD or secure store per policy.
manual_commands: Get-BitLockerVolume | Select MountPoint, VolumeStatus, ProtectionStatus, EncryptionPercentage, EncryptionMethod

checks.expected_setting: Windows Defender real-time protection enabled; tamper protection on where supported; signatures up to date.
checks.remediation_guidance: Enable real-time protection and keep definitions current. Enable tamper protection (Set-MpPreference -DisableTamperProtection $false) to prevent disabling by non-admin.

checks.expected_setting: AppLocker or WDAC policy enforced; executable and script rules limit execution to approved paths.
checks.remediation_guidance: Deploy AppLocker or WDAC policy via GPO. Enforce rules for EXE, script, and optionally MSI. Default deny with explicit allow for Program Files and approved paths.

checks.expected_setting: FIPS mode enabled if required (HKLM Lsa FipsAlgorithmPolicy = 1); TLS 1.0/1.1 disabled; TLS 1.2 and 1.3 enabled for Schannel.
checks.remediation_guidance: If FIPS required: set FipsAlgorithmPolicy Enabled = 1. Disable TLS 1.0/1.1 and enable TLS 1.2/1.3 via registry or GPO under SCHANNEL.
